To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
e-commerce adoption is not an isolated event, but is a strategic decision that should be made within the context of an overall strategy for the business.

(a) the relationship between technology adoption (i.e., ecommerce) and business strategy is not a simple one; (b) the adoption of e-commerce may be associated with the development of new business strategies; (c) the adoption of ecommerce is not necessarily associated with the development or implementation of new business strategies, and may be associated with a change in existing business strategies; (d) the adoption of new business strategy is a function of the nature of the business and the business context; (
the adoption of e-commerce in the business-to-business market is not a simple matter of applying a technology to existing business processes and strategies.

how a business-to-business firm can use e-commerce technology to achieve its business objectives.
